picks.what: View from the west with the castle hill, engraving
picks.why: general view of the town on the bay below the Arechi castle; caption and margins cut

picks.what: Panorama from the west with the port, wood engraving in Le Cento Città d’Italia
picks.why: clear wide view of the city, harbor and castle hill; large scan

picks.what: View over the city and the bay from the hills, photograph

gaps: P0, P1, P2: no candidates; P5: only distant Mittelholzer aerials of the bay (#14–#16)
notes: Second P4 not possible: #13 (1879, port view) is too close to #11; #9 (Alinari photo, ca. 1880–95) has the city small behind a tree. Skipped #12 (Horner watercolor, dated only ‘19th century’), #7 and #2 (dated only 1850–1899 and 1800–1900), #10 (looks like the Sorrento coast with Vesuvius, undated), #3–#6 (Vietri and La Trinità, not the city), #8 (1864 drawing of a seafront corner, small), #18–#20 (space-station photos), #21 (apartment blocks).
